title: Limited visual presentation of text (AAA)
user_impact: Users with visual impairments or dyslexia have difficulty reading.
technical_impact: Insufficient CSS styling for line spacing or justified-text formatting.
source: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.8 Visual Presentation (Level AAA), bullet 4: line spacing at least space-and-a-half
applicability: Blocks of text: paragraphs with text content that are rendered.
expectation:
One page-level review when at least one rendered paragraph has an effective
line height below 1.5 times the font size, from a stylesheet, the style
attribute, or a media query applying in an audited viewport. Exactly 1.5
passes, 1.4 does not. A tight value on html (normalize.css) that the
paragraphs override does not count; captions and headings are not blocks of
text. Review, not a violation.
